whatWeDo: Every month the Firekin gather for a charity marathon, a longer cosy stream where everything we raise goes straight to a cause that matters to this community.
Past marathons have supported causes close to our hearts, including Rainbow Railroad, who help LGBTQIA+ people find safety from persecution.
There is never any pressure to give. Lurking, cheering, and spreading the word all help just as much. Every little bit is welcome, and so are you.

cause.name: Rainbow Railroad
cause.desc: Helping LGBTQIA+ people escape violence and persecution, and find safety.

steps: Donations run through Tiltify. The donate button takes you to our official campaign page, safe and secure.
Every penny goes to the cause. Funds are handled by Tiltify and sent directly to the charity.
Watch it grow on stream. Donations show up live during the marathon, with celebrations along the way.
